verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a code-security scanner, so dependency remediation is a fair axis to ask about, but the evidence covers only secret detection, verification, analysis and key-rotation alerts. Nothing shows dependency vulnerability scanning, upgrade-path guidance, or automated fix pull requests. The secret-remediation tracking feature is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get concrete upgrade paths or automated fix pull requests that remediate vulnerable dependencies
